pages.text: One might ask "How do I keep a certain amount of an item in stock, crafting more as needed?"$(br2)One solution is use of an $(l:items_blocks_machines/export_bus)ME Export Bus$(/l), $(l:items_blocks_machines/level_emitter)ME Level Emitter$(/l), and $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Crafting Card$(/l) to automatically request new items from your network's $(l:ae2_mechanics/autocrafting)autocrafting$(/l). This setup is for maintaining a large quantity of one item.
You can of course make your network craft continuously, by omitting the level emitter and redstone card.$(br2)$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()

pages.title: Configurations
pages.text: $(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/export_bus)ME Export Bus$(/l) (1) is filtered to the desired item. It has a $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Redstone Card$(/l) and $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Crafting Card$(/l). The "Redstone Mode" is set to "Active with signal", The "Crafting Behavior" is set to "Do not use stocked items".$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/level_emitter)ME Level Emitter$(/l) (2) is configured with the desired item and quantity, and set to "Emit when levels are below limit".$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/interface)ME Interface$(/l) (3) is in

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: 1. If the amount of the desired item in $(l:ae2_mechanics/import_export_storage)network storage$(/l) is below the quantity specified in the $(l:items_blocks_machines/level_emitter)ME Level Emitter$(/l), it will emit a redstone signal.$(br2)2. Upon receiving a redstone signal (and due to the $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Crafting Card$(/l) and being set to not use stocked items), the $(l:items_blocks_machines/export_bus)ME Export Bus$(/l) will request that the network's $(l:ae2_mechanics/autocrafting)autocrafting$(/l) craft more of the desired item, then export it.

3. Upon having an item pushed into it (and not being configured to have anything in its internal inventory), the $(l:items_blocks_machines/interface)ME Interface$(/l) will push that item into network storage.
